caption: The drawing depicts a square geometric pattern resembling a textile or weaving design. The composition consists of a navy blue background with red, white, and lighter blue elements. There are four large red squares located in each quadrant, interconnected by red and white lines forming a grid. The center of the design features a concentric square pattern made up of white squares on a blue background, creating a diamond arrangement. Surrounding the central area and extending throughout the piece are alternating patterns of rectangular, linear, and checkered shapes in red, white, and blue. The left and bottom edges of the square display a fringe effect with alternating red, white, and blue lines, suggesting the appearance of textile threads. The entire design is bordered by a thin, double-lined frame, and the artist's signature is visible in the lower right corner. The composition is centered on a neutral, lightly colored background.
title: Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
